items.title: War in Middle East could last a month, Trump says
items.description: Fresh explosions rock Tehran as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu vows to intensify air strikes. Follow live.

items.title: Hanson censured over no 'good' Muslims comment, Coalition votes against
items.description: Two Liberal senators cross the floor to vote for Labor's motion that censured the One Nation leader for "inflammatory and divisive comments" that sought to vilify Muslim Australians.

items.title: Coalition brands Australian children in Syria terrorist 'sympathisers'
items.description: Opposition leader Angus Taylor has escalated his attack on the federal government over its response to the so-called "ISIS brides" cohort.

items.title: Police watchdog issues extraordinary apology to family violence victim
items.description: IBAC's public apology to Jana Katerinskaja is a sharp reminder of the struggle for accountability victims of police-perpetrated family violence too often face.

items.title: 'Grossly unfair': Grandad fights AI seatbelt fines after daughter penalised
items.description: Frustration is deepening over drivers being ordered to pay hundreds of dollars in fines for infringements incurred by their passengers — including young children and neurodivergent people not wearing seatbelts correctly.

items.title: 'They basically stole the word': Farmers fight to reclaim 'milk'
items.description: Australian dairy farmers say the plant-based drinks industry has "stolen" the word milk, and they are pointing to a recent court ruling as an opportunity to claim it back.

items.title: Father who fell to his death zip-lining was on 'bucket list' trip, inquest hears
items.description: A coronial inquest into the 2019 death of 50-year-old Dean Sanderson has heard the mining project manager was visiting Far North Queensland with his wife, after "a pretty terrible health situation".

items.title: 'Traumatised' patients left out of gynaecologist Simon Gordon review
items.description: Women who had surgery for "severe" endometriosis despite pathology showing little trace of the disease are angry and upset that Epworth Hospital has not invited them to participate in an external review.

items.title: 'Disgusted': NSW government grants approval to controversial mine
items.description: The NSW government grants a six-year extension to a controversial coal mine in the Hunter Valley.

items.title: Brisbane house prices hit new peak as national market growth continues
items.description: The average home in Brisbane is now worth $1,046,000 — an increase of 15.9 per cent since the same time last year, according to data from Proptrack.

items.title: The theory on why Trump tried to protect 'his friends and the Epstein class'
items.description: Many Trump supporters wanted to send those implicated in Jeffrey Epstein's sex trafficking ring "off to the gallows", before the US president did a back flip on releasing the files. What followed was an unusual political manoeuvre and acts of immense bravery by survivors.

items.title: 'A tax on households': Economists warn Middle East war to spike oil
items.description: The average household could see $14 added to their weekly petrol bill, a prominent economist has warned. While oil prices have already spiked, analysts are hopeful the conflict will be short-lived, limiting the fallout.

items.title: Hawks to appeal star midfielder's rough conduct ban
items.description: Gun midfielder Jai Newcombe will challenge his one-match ban for rough conduct in a bid to play in Hawthorn's season opener against GWS.

items.title: Simple recipes to celebrate autumn and enjoy the cosy kitchen
items.description: We’ve crunched the numbers and these are five of your favourite ever autumn recipes to look forward to this season.

items.title: 'Haven't looked back': How Max's move to the country changed his life
items.description: Moving to the country might sound idyllic to overstimulated and stressed-out city dwellers, but for Max and Courtney, it took some soul-searching to find their purpose and a place to really call home.

items.title: History quiz: Can you work your way backward through these questions?
items.description: Where was MH370 heading, which Australian won our first Oscar and what was the world's first vampire movie?

items.title: What is known about Iran girls' school strike as death toll rises
items.description: Iran says the death toll from an attack on a girls' school it claims was launched by the US and Israel has surpassed 165.

items.title: Emergency powers invoked as flood risk rises across Central Australia
items.description: An emergency has been declared as as a tropical low brings heavy rain, rising river levels and flooding risks to Central Australia and the Barkly region.

items.title: Qld on cyclone watch as rain drenches parts of state
items.description: Parts of Queensland are drenched after more than 200 millimetres of rain fell in less than 24 hours — and there is more rain and potentially a cyclone on the way.

items.title: Men claiming to be council contractors chop Bondi tree
items.description: Residents of a quiet street in Bondi are split after men wearing high-vis and wielding chainsaws allegedly illegally destroyed a tree.

items.title: Woman who died after being shot with bean-bag round threw axe at police, inquest hears
items.description: An inquest has been told a Newcastle woman who died after being shot with a bean-bag round, threw an axe at police when they entered her home.

items.title: Former gym teacher sentenced over historical child sex offences
items.description: A man who taught gymnastics at an all-boys Catholic school in the Riverina has been sentenced to three years in prison for historical child sex offences.

items.title: Newborn left at fire station 'thriving' amidst appeal for more information
items.description: The baby boy found at a south Canberra fire station in November last year is "safe" and "thriving" in foster care, as the ACT government issues a fresh appeal for information.

items.title: Inquest told details of man believed to be last to see Sydney woman alive
items.description: An inquest has heard Sydney woman Jessica Zrinski went missing in November 2022 after meeting a man she did not know in a pub car park.

items.title: AFL's Opening Round and State of Origin here to stay, says Dillon
items.description: AFL chief Andrew Dillon backs the contentious Opening Round format and says State of Origin matches are here to stay.
